item.title: Mercury in the 1st house: what it means
item.description: Mercury in the 1st house means Mercury sat in the part of your chart that deals with self and beginnings when you were born. In astrology Mercury stands for how you think and speak. Mercury in your house of self and beginnings makes mind and presence the same thing. Read more at astralroots.app
